GO enrichment with ranked gene list

Source: R/enrichGO_rank.R
enrichGO_rank.Rd

Gene ontology enrichment analysis of a ranked gene list with clusterProfiler. Genes can be ranked by variance decomposition results.

Usage

enrichGO_rank(
  rank_table,
  gene_rank_by,
  OrgDb,
  keyType = "SYMBOL",
  go_rank_by = "p.adjust",
  category = NULL,
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  simplify = FALSE,
  simplify_cutoff = 0.7,
  simplify_by = "p.adjust",
  simplify_select_fun = min,
  simplify_measure = "Wang",
  ...
)

Arguments

rank_table

A data frame with at least two columns: 'Feature' for gene names and one or more columns of variables for ranking the genes, e.g. output of decomp_variance() containing variance decomposition results

gene_rank_by

Variable in rank_table to rank the genes by, e.g. "Time", "Group" in the output of decomp_variance()

OrgDb

Organism database, e.g. org.Hs.eg.db, org.Mm.eg.db

keyType

Available options are AnnotationDbi::keytypes(OrgDb) (default is "SYMBOL")

go_rank_by

Variable in the GO enrichment result to rank the GO terms by (default is "p.adjust", other options include "pvalue", "qvalue", "NES", "setSize", "enrichmentScore", etc.)

category

GO category to analyze (default is all three of BP, MF, CC)

pvalueCutoff

Parameter of clusterProfiler::gseGO() (default is 0.05)

pAdjustMethod

Parameter of clusterProfiler::gseGO() (default is "BH")

simplify

Whether to simplify the GO terms by removing redundant terms with clusterProfiler::simplify() (default is FALSE)

simplify_cutoff

Parameter of clusterProfiler::simplify(), cutoff for similarity when simplifying GO terms (default is 0.7)

simplify_by

Parameter of clusterProfiler::simplify(), method to choose the representative term (default is "p.adjust")

simplify_select_fun

Parameter of clusterProfiler::simplify(), function to select the representative term (default is min)

simplify_measure

Parameter of clusterProfiler::simplify(), method to calculate similarity when simplifying GO terms (default is "Wang")

...

additional arguments passed to clusterProfiler::gseGO()

Value

A list containing all, a list of gseaResult objects with the GSEA results. If simplify = TRUE, the output also contains simplified, a list of simplified gseaResult objects.

Examples

if (requireNamespace("org.Mm.eg.db", quietly = TRUE)) {
    library(org.Mm.eg.db)
    data(example_obj)

    var_decomp <- decomp_variance(example_obj,
        features = rownames(example_obj)[1:100], assay = 1)
    example_go_rank <- enrichGO_rank(var_decomp, gene_rank_by = "Time",
        OrgDb = org.Mm.eg.db, keyType = "SYMBOL",
        category = "BP")
}
#> LMM: exp ~ (1|Group) + (1|Time)  |  Output: Group, Time, Residual
#> 100 features evaluated: 71 successful; 0 errors; 29 warnings; 0 skipped before fitting for insufficient observations or variance.
#> Warning: There were 1 pathways for which P-values were not calculated properly; pvalue, NES and log2err are set to NA for them. The usual cause is an unbalanced gene-level statistic (no genes on one side of the ranking), which makes the permutation null degenerate; a gene set covering the whole ranked list is excluded before this point. You can try to increase nPermSimple, or pass reportNA = TRUE to keep these rows.
#> Warning: Invalid p-values detected (NA, non-finite, <0, or >1). qvalue will be computed on valid p-values only.
#> Warning: 1 of 151 gene set(s) have no estimable p-value and were dropped (pvalue, NES and log2err are NA for them). Pass reportNA = TRUE to keep them, or raise nPermSimple.
#> No significant GO terms found for category: BP
#> No significant GO terms found in any category.
